_comment: What the market shipped, measured rather than repeated. Every row is a
product we looked at ourselves; `measured` is the day we looked, and it is
printed on the page beside the number, because a version without a date is
a claim that ages into a lie.
This file is edited by a person, on purpose. Our own version is read from
the repository by build.py and can never drift; a competitor's cannot be
fetched without installing their product, so pretending the page polls
them live would be the one dishonest thing on it.
Source: docs/08-competitors.md, the table of cores on 05.11.2026, with the
source and the date of every row. Dolphin Anty publishes no changelog, so
its number is the least certain one here, and the page says so.
Fury's own `chrome` here is not used: build.py puts the major from
core/CHROMIUM_VERSION in its place, so this file cannot make it stale.
A row with `engine` is not Chromium: its `chrome` holds that engine's own
version, which build.py prints without a bar, since Firefox 158 is not
ahead of Chrome 157 in any sense the bar would show.
